relation: two separate public views of GTBase.walk_usage, with no identification between them. Finite undirected pair occurrence: GTMisc.D7.walk_uses s p u v is seq_consecutiveb (s :: p) u v by conversion, the Boolean form of B3's GTBase.walks_paths.seq_consecutive (same body with || for \/, reflected by seq_consecutivebP, equal to MathComp's infix test by seq_consecutivebE): u and v are adjacent entries of s :: p in either order; no edge, nonempty-walk, uniqueness, distinct-endpoint or terminal premise; an empty tail uses nothing and a repeated adjacent value uses its loop pair. Alternating oriented usage: Infinite.D4inf4.walk_uses b x p a c is alt_uses b x p a c over the vertex Type of an iDigraph (an explicit iff by induction): some step of x :: p, read with polarity b flipping at every step, is (a, c) in its current orientation; Prop with propositional equality, no arc, no alt_walk_from validity, no eqType, choice or inhabitance. On an eqType carrier alt_uses implies consecutive occurrence (alt_uses_consecutive); the converse fails. Distinct and untouched: Cycle.D1.edp_feasible, an edge-labelled multigraph routing homonym of a D7 chain name.
summary: B28 walk-uses, two separate classes. GTMisc D7's `walk_uses s p u v` (Boolean: `(u, v)` or `(v, u)` is a pair of `zip (s :: p) p`) is `GTBase.walk_usage.seq_consecutiveb (s :: p) u v` by conversion, the Boolean view of B3's `seq_consecutive` (reflection `seq_consecutivebP`, MathComp `infix` form `seq_consecutivebE`; B3 keeps its module and ownership). Infinite D4inf4's recursive `walk_uses b x p a c` over the vertex Type of an `iDigraph` is `GTBase.walk_usage.alt_uses b x p a c`, the same recursion over any Type, by an induction on the tail. No edge, walk validity, eqType, choice or inhabitance assumption is added; the classes are not identified (`alt_uses_consecutive` states the only valid direction, on an eqType carrier).

Corners in the public-only client base/theories/examples/walk_usage.v: empty and one-entry sequences, symmetry, a repeated adjacent value, no cyclic closing pair; the alternating head step at both polarities over an arbitrary Type, the empty tail, two-step parity and the wrong orientation of a forward step, which the finite view accepts.

Frozen at 016b868 with every guard: D7's chain `edp_feasible` (both clauses), `edp_opt`, `edp_ratio_spec` (Wagner guard, rho of the order) and `maxedp_approx` (one program realizes and is polynomial on `enc_edp`) and the OPG row (exists p rho, maxedp_approx p rho /\ little_o_sqrt rho; its documented improvement-branch and value-estimation reading is kept; the older two-branch wording of D7's Row 2 section comment and of the implications_D7 header is recorded, not repaired), all by conversion; D4inf4's `universal` and its OPG row (local finiteness, high arc transitivity, universality and the three nonvacuity guards), by pointwise transport. Two whole iff; no earlier snapshot, so no Original. Routes: D7 (graph-theory-misc) and D4inf4 (infinite-graph-theory); no Digraph source.
